find_package_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, mustWork = TRUE)
  while (TRUE) {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, "DESCRIPTION")) && dir.exists(file.path(path, "R"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Could not find package root containing DESCRIPTION and R/.")
    }
    path <- parent
  }

  return(path)
}

package_root <- find_package_root()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = package_root)
devtools::load_all(package_root, quiet = TRUE)

This playground uses the package test MOO object and runs the public filter_counts() wrapper. The examples below keep the CPM filtering settings the same while comparing total-sample filtering and group-based filtering.

Load Test Data

moo <- readr::read_rds("tests/testthat/data/moo.rds")

count_type <- "clean"
feature_id_colname <- "GeneName"
sample_id_colname <- "Sample"
group_colname <- "Group"
label_colname <- "Label"

sample_metadata <- as.data.frame(moo@sample_meta)
counts_before <- as.data.frame(moo@counts[[count_type]])
sample_columns <- setdiff(colnames(counts_before), feature_id_colname)

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  count_type = count_type,
  features_before_filtering = nrow(counts_before),
  samples = length(sample_columns),
  feature_id_colname = feature_id_colname,
  sample_id_colname = sample_id_colname,
  group_colname = group_colname,
  check.names = FALSE
))
count_type features_before_filtering samples feature_id_colname sample_id_colname group_colname
clean 43280 9 GeneName Sample Group

Filtering Parameters

minimum_count_value_to_be_considered_nonzero <- 4
minimum_number_of_samples_with_nonzero_counts_in_a_group <- 2
minimum_number_of_samples_with_nonzero_counts_in_total <- 8
use_cpm_counts_to_filter <- TRUE
use_group_based_filtering <- FALSE

CPM Passing-Sample Summary

This table counts how many samples pass the CPM threshold for each feature. A feature kept with a total minimum of 8 can still have low values in up to two samples.

cpm_counts <- counts_before
cpm_counts[, sample_columns] <- edgeR::cpm(as.matrix(counts_before[, sample_columns]))

passing_matrix <- as.matrix(cpm_counts[, sample_columns]) >=
  minimum_count_value_to_be_considered_nonzero
passing_sample_counts <- rowSums(passing_matrix)

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  passing_samples = sort(unique(passing_sample_counts)),
  features = as.integer(tabulate(
    match(passing_sample_counts, sort(unique(passing_sample_counts))),
    nbins = length(unique(passing_sample_counts))
  )),
  kept_when_total_minimum_is_8 = sort(unique(passing_sample_counts)) >= 8,
  kept_when_total_minimum_is_9 = sort(unique(passing_sample_counts)) >= 9,
  check.names = FALSE
))
passing_samples features kept_when_total_minimum_is_8 kept_when_total_minimum_is_9

1 1256 FALSE FALSE
2 660 FALSE FALSE
3 503 FALSE FALSE

CPM Passing Samples By Group

Group-based filtering uses the same CPM threshold as total-sample filtering, but the sample minimum is counted within each group. A feature is kept when at least one group reaches the group minimum.

sample_groups <- sample_metadata[[group_colname]][
  match(sample_columns, sample_metadata[[sample_id_colname]])
]
group_names <- unique(stats::na.omit(sample_groups))

passing_by_group <- vapply(
  group_names,
  function(group_name) {
    group_sample_columns <- sample_columns[sample_groups == group_name]
    return(rowSums(passing_matrix[, group_sample_columns, drop = FALSE]))
  },
  numeric(nrow(passing_matrix))
)

group_keep <- rowSums(
  passing_by_group >= minimum_number_of_samples_with_nonzero_counts_in_a_group
) >= 1
total_keep <- passing_sample_counts >= minimum_number_of_samples_with_nonzero_counts_in_total

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  setting = c(
    "total-sample rule",
    "group-based rule",
    "kept by group only",
    "kept by total only"
  ),
  features = c(
    sum(total_keep),
    sum(group_keep),
    sum(group_keep & !total_keep),
    sum(total_keep & !group_keep)
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
))
setting features
total-sample rule 7811
group-based rule 10836
kept by group only 3025
kept by total only 0 
group_only_features <- counts_before[[feature_id_colname]][group_keep & !total_keep]

if (length(group_only_features) > 0) {
  group_only_summary <- data.frame(
    feature = group_only_features,
    total_passing_samples = passing_sample_counts[group_keep & !total_keep],
    passing_by_group[group_keep & !total_keep, , drop = FALSE],
    check.names = FALSE
  ) |>
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)

  knitr::kable(group_only_summary)
} else {
  knitr::kable(data.frame(message = "No features were kept only by group-based filtering."))
}

  use_cpm_counts_to_filter = use_cpm_counts_to_filter,

8 vs 9 Summary

counts_total_8 <- as.data.frame(filtered_moo_total_8@counts[["filt"]])
counts_total_9 <- as.data.frame(filtered_moo_total_9@counts[["filt"]])

features_total_8 <- counts_total_8[[feature_id_colname]]
features_total_9 <- counts_total_9[[feature_id_colname]]
features_kept_only_by_8 <- setdiff(features_total_8, features_total_9)

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  setting = c("total minimum 8", "total minimum 9", "kept by 8 only"),
  features = c(
    length(features_total_8),
    length(features_total_9),
    length(features_kept_only_by_8)
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
))
setting features
total minimum 8 6165
total minimum 9 6165
kept by 8 only 0

Total vs Group-Based Summary

counts_group_2 <- as.data.frame(filtered_moo_group_2@counts[["filt"]])
features_group_2 <- counts_group_2[[feature_id_colname]]
features_kept_only_by_group <- setdiff(features_group_2, features_total_8)
features_kept_only_by_total <- setdiff(features_total_8, features_group_2)

  setting = c(
    "total minimum 8",
    "group minimum 2",
    "kept by group only",
    "kept by total only"

    length(features_total_8),
    length(features_group_2),
    length(features_kept_only_by_group),
    length(features_kept_only_by_total)

  check.names = FALSE
))
